summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Vangjush Dako, presented as the current mayor of Durrës, Albania. It states that he was elected after the February 2007 local elections and that he belongs to the Socialist Party of Albania.
one_line: Vangjush Dako is an Albanian politician, elected mayor of Durrës after the February 2007 local elections as a Socialist Party member.
key_facts: Vangjush Dako is the current mayor of the city of Durrës, Albania.
Vangjush Dako was elected mayor of Durrës following the February 2007 local elections.
Vangjush Dako is a member of the Socialist Party of Albania.
